Apple has updated its official Design Resources website with new product bezel materials for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, following today's "Surprise and Shine" event. Details below.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezel materials now available

Designers are no strangers to the Apple Design Resources website — a platform offering a wide variety of hardware and software assets for use in their own projects.

These include Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG and SVG assets for Apple platforms, products and technologies, as well as fonts, SF Symbols, Apple's Icon Composer, and badges and logos for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

Following today's announcement of the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, Apple has updated the Design Resources website with Photoshop and PNG assets for both new devices.

The assets include images of the iPhone Duo in both unfolded and folded forms across two colour options, as well as multiple iPhone 18 Pro models featuring a smaller Dynamic Island.

To check out these new bezel materials, along with other existing assets on the Apple Design Resources website, click this link.
